description: Change a program intake request's answers by hand: set a value, mark an item as not applying (with a reason), confirm a suggestion, or clear one. Values are checked against the definition (kind, options, secrets); a person is a name and an optional email, and the platform links an AnyForge member from the email itself. Send `expectedAt` (the answer's `at` from the read, or null) so a concurrent change is refused instead of overwritten. The edit is audited; it does not re-open approval or notify followers. Requires `write` scope and a key holder who can edit initiatives.

edits.description: One or more edits, at most one per item.

doesNotApply.description: For set: the item does not apply to this request. Send reason and no value. Any item a person answers can be marked; it does not block the request.

expectedAt.description: The `at` of the answer you read (null if there was none).

reason.description: With doesNotApply: why the item does not apply.

value.description: For set: text, a list of strings, an option value, a list of option values, true or false, YYYY-MM-DD, or { name, email? } for a person.

initiativeId.description: An initiative a program intake agent created. Pass this or workItemId.

workItemId.description: A program intake draft or completed request. Pass this or initiativeId.

name: anyforge_edit_intake_request_details
title: Edit intake request details
